items.name: Banjarmasin Cube Day 2027

venue.name: [POP Hotel Banjarmasin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ysbBgT1QYtNLXhNq6)
venue.address: Jl. H.Djok Mentaya No.50, Kertak Baru Ilir, Kec. Banjarmasin Tengah, Kota Banjarmasin, Kalimantan Selatan 70111

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE5MzMyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5a8e6a9339ec92ef754449fd0259f7b028f08090/LOGO%20BCD%2027%20REV-02.jpg) Banjarmasin Cube Day 2027 merupakan kompetisi speedcubing yang kembali hadir di Banjarmasin setelah 17 tahun sejak terakhir diselenggarakannya Borneo Championship 2010. Kompetisi ini akan diselenggarakan selama 1 hari di POP Hotel Banjarmasin dengan 3x3x3 sebagai cabang utama. Kompetisi ini terbuka untuk seluruh warga negara. Registrasi dapat dilakukan pada laman [Daftar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BanjarmasinCubeDay2027/register). Pastikan Anda melampirkan bukti transfer pada [Formulir ini](https://forms.gle/5tobVNB3PHvm4fiK7) Kami tidak akan menerima pendaftaran Anda jika Anda belum melakukan konfirmasi kepada kami. Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, silakan menghubungi kontak yang tersedia ----------- Banjarmasin Cube Day 2027 is an speedcubing competition returning to Banjarmasin after 17 years since the last Borneo Championship in 2010. The competition will be held for 1 day with 3x3x3 as the main event. The competition will be held at POP Hotel Banjarmasin and is open to all nationalities. Registration can be done on the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BanjarmasinCubeDay2027/register) page. Make sure you submit your proof of transfer on [This Form](https://forms.gle/5tobVNB3PHvm4fiK7) We will not accept your registration if you have not confirmed it with us. For further information, please contact the contact provided. ----------- Important In accordance with articles 2g, 2k, and 2l, competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA Regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA4MDkyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--84e4edf1c283f775bdc003094c6b7e11586c06ea/option1_1_250x250.png) [FR] 🇨🇵 On est de retour à Genève pour la première compétition FTO de Suisse romande ! Tous ceux qui souhaitent commencer l’année avec un résultat FTO officiel sont les bienvenus. Cette compétition marque la fin de près de deux ans d’absence de compétitions à Genève, tout en offrant aux cubers locaux l’occasion de participer à cet événement WCA récemment reconnu. __________________________________________________________________ [EN] 🇬🇧 We’re back in Geneva for the first FTO competition in Romandie! Anyone wanting to start the year with an official FTO result is welcome. This competition marks the end of a nearly two-year hiatus from competitions in Geneva, while offering local cubers the chance to take part in this newly recognised WCA event.
